name: work-os
description: Work OS discipline system installer. Detects agent hosts, installs the full system as a Hermes profile (preferred) or generic plugin pack.

actions_hermes.desc: Create/refresh ~/.hermes/profiles/work-os with SOUL.md + 18 system skills + 30 external skills + memory/
Copy model/provider block from user's active config (never ships keys)
hermes doctor check + enable toolsets: skills memory delegation file terminal code_execution
One-shot chat proving SOUL loaded (routing block appears in response)

actions_generic.desc: Install marketplace plugin pack (AGENTS.md protocol + 9 portable skills)
Copy memory/ seed into user project, point protocol paths at it

optional.name: rsync
optional.why: fast skill-sync path + external-drive backup layer (cp -R fallback in install.sh if absent; auto on macos/linux)

accounts.name: LLM provider key
accounts.how: copied from your existing hermes config; nothing shipped

accounts.name: GitHub token (repo-scoped)
accounts.how: only if you adopt GitHub backup; see skills in the pack
